Notes: Clear yes/no definition; single-day post-gap bursts (gabinsane) were not counted as recovery by either rater.
Free-text; most mismatches were vague reasons ("simple break", "maintenance behind commits") vs. triggers named in post-gap commits. Resolved by combining gap cause and recovery trigger.
Steady vs declining/irregular confusion; resolved by checking yearly totals, and "stopped" applied when activity ceased.
Two projects mislabeled Inactive despite commits after the 2025-04-01 cutoff; resolved by applying the date rule literally.
Merge commits, version-tag commits and bot deploys were coded inconsistently; resolved by agreeing merges = Other, tags = Release, bot deploys = Automated bot contributions.
